Двухуровневые архитектуры: Helix, GR00T,: Dual-system architectures: Helix, GR00T, Gemini Robotics
Обобщение и рассуждение: от π0.5 до π0.7: Generalization and reasoning: from π0.5 to π0.7
Политику вроде RT-1 обучают на 300 демон: A policy like RT-1 is trained on 300 demonstrations, and you choose how many bins to split each action dimension into: 8 or 256. What will a test on new scenes show?
8 корзин обучатся, но будут промахиватьс: 8 bins will train but miss because the grid is coarse; 256 will barely train: there are more classes than examples
256 корзин выиграют: мельче корзина — то: 256 bins will win: the finer the bin, the more precise the action
Разницы не будет: число корзин влияет то: There'll be no difference: the number of bins only affects speed
Корзина — класс, и на каждый класс нужны: A bin is a class, and every class needs examples. RT-1 could afford 256 bins with 130,000 episodes; in the lab, with 300 demonstrations, 16–32 bins won.
В RT-1 текст команды входит в сеть одним: In RT-1, the command text enters the network as a single vector through FiLM inside EfficientNet. What's the advantage over adding text tokens in front of the transformer?
Признаки картинки извлекаются с учётом к: The image features are extracted with the command in mind: from the very start, the network looks at what it's being asked about
Экономию памяти: вектор команды короче т: Memory savings: the command vector is shorter than the tokens
Ничего: авторы выбрали FiLM из-за готово: Nothing: the authors chose FiLM because the code was already there
Это ранняя подача языка. У Gato язык доб: This is early language fusion. In Gato, language is added late, and the RT-1 authors link that to its weakness with distractors: 43% versus 83% for RT-1.
От кадра до токенов действия: From a frame to action tokens
Бюджет позволяет собрать ещё 30 тысяч де: The budget covers 30,000 more demonstrations for RT-1. Which pays off more for generalization to new instructions: repeating the same 700 tasks, or adding new tasks and objects with fewer episodes per task?
Новые задачи: убрать 25% задач при 97% э: New tasks: removing 25% of the tasks while keeping 97% of the episodes cost as much generalization as removing 49% of the episodes
Те же задачи: модель лучше запоминает зн: The same tasks: the model remembers familiar things better
Всё равно: обобщение зависит только от р: It makes no difference: generalization depends only on the model size
Таблица абляций: 54% обобщения без четве: The ablation table: 54% generalization without a quarter of the tasks versus 50% without half the episodes but with all the tasks. Data diversity matters more than data quantity, and this conclusion led to Open X-Embodiment.
Шесть кадров по 81 токену — 486 токенов: Six frames of 81 tokens each make 486 tokens per step. How does RT-1, with 35M parameters, manage to output an action three times per second?
TokenLearner оставляет 8 токенов на кадр: TokenLearner keeps 8 tokens per frame, the transformer reads 48, and the tokens of past frames are reused
Трансформер читает только последний кадр: The transformer reads only the latest frame
Внимание заменено свёрткой по времени: Attention is replaced with a convolution over time
Мягкий отбор токенов ускоряет сеть в 2,4: Soft token selection speeds the network up 2.4×; together with reusing tokens, that gives 15 ms per action. The number of tokens is the main lever on cost, as in lesson 1.6.
ViT обучили без векторов позиций. Картин: A ViT was trained without position vectors. An image with a cube and a ball is shuffled patch by patch, like a mosaic, and fed to the model. What changes in its output?
Почти ничего: без позиций вход для внима: Almost nothing: without positions, the input to attention is a bag of patches, and the model can't see their order
Модель перестанет узнавать предметы: нар: The model stops recognizing the objects: the boundaries between them are broken
Выход станет случайным: внимание не умее: The output becomes random: attention can't handle shuffled input
Внимание не знает порядка входов. Позици: Attention doesn't know the order of its inputs. Positions bring the order back; in the ablation, ViT without them gets 0.614 versus 0.642, and which way you encode positions hardly matters.
Команда собирает VLM из готового энкодер: A team is assembling a VLM from a ready-made CLIP encoder and a ready-made language model. What will they have to train in the first stage of the LLaVA recipe?
Только проектор: матрицу, которая перево: Only the projector, a matrix that maps the encoder's tokens to the dimension of the word embeddings; the encoder and the language model are frozen
Энкодер: он должен научиться выдавать то: The encoder: it has to learn to output tokens the language model understands
Всё сразу: иначе части не договорятся: Everything at once: otherwise the parts won't work together
H_v = W · Z_v: мост между частями дешёвы: H_v = W · Z_v: the bridge between the parts is cheap. What's expensive is the parts themselves and the data; in the second stage, the language model is trained together with the projector, and the CLIP encoder stays frozen throughout.
LLaVA и PaliGemma: проектор между энкоде: LLaVA and PaliGemma: a projector between the encoder and the language model
Энкодер мини-VLM в контрастном пространс: In the contrastive space, the mini-VLM's encoder recognizes the purple cube. But in the training captions, the word “purple” was followed by “ball”, “bowl” and “can”, and never by “cube”. What will the VLM say about an image of a purple cube?
Скорее «фиолетовый мяч»: языковая модель: Most likely “purple ball”: the language model also answers from habits picked up from the captions, not just from the encoder features
«Фиолетовый кубик»: языковая модель чита: “Purple cube”: the language model reads what the encoder outputs
Откажется отвечать: такого сочетания в д: It refuses to answer: that combination wasn't in the data
Цвет модель прочитала из картинки, а фор: The model read the color from the image but finished the shape after the word “purple” from the captions: in the lab, it called the purple cube a ball. The LLaVA authors describe the same failure: asked about strawberry-flavored yogurt, the model answered “yes”, although the fridge held yogurt and strawberries separately. What the encoder knows and what the language model is used to are different things.
Робот на PaliGemma получает кадр 224 px: A robot built on PaliGemma gets a 224 px frame and a command. How many image tokens will the language model read at every control step, and why does that matter for a robot?
256 токенов; при 896 px было бы 4096, и: 256 tokens; at 896 px it would be 4096, and that's the price of every control step, which is why GR00T N1 keeps 64 tokens per frame
16 токенов: энкодер сжимает картинку до: 16 tokens: the encoder compresses the image to a few features
Один токен на картинку, как один вектор: One token per image, like the single command vector in RT-1
Картинку приводят к квадрату 224, 448 ил: The image is resized to a square of 224, 448 or 896 pixels: 256, 1024 or 4096 tokens. Attention gets more expensive as the number of tokens grows, and the robot pays for them at every step.
Что добавили к готовой модели зрения и я: What was added to a ready-made vision-language model so that RT-2 would output robot actions?
Ничего нового: действие записано строкой: Nothing new: the action is written as a string of eight vocabulary tokens in the model's answer
Отдельную голову регрессии поверх языков: A separate regression head on top of the language model
Второй визуальный энкодер для камеры на: A second vision encoder for the camera on the arm
Авторы подчёркивают, что модель обучают: The authors stress that the model is trained without any new parameters: an action is the same kind of token string as the words of an answer. In PaLI-X, numbers up to 1000 have tokens of their own; in PaLM-E, the 256 least frequently used tokens were overwritten for actions.
Готовую модель зрения и языка дообучили: A ready-made vision-language model was fine-tuned on robot demonstrations only, without web data. What happens to its knowledge of the world?
Она начнёт забывать понятия из предобуче: It starts forgetting concepts from pre-training and generalizes worse to new objects
Ничего: веса языковой модели почти не ме: Nothing: the language model's weights barely change
Она станет лучше понимать картинки, пото: It gets better at understanding images because it sees more frames
Так модель забывает старое. В таблице 6: That's how a model forgets what it knew. In Table 6 of the paper, co-fine-tuning at 55B parameters generalizes in 63% of cases versus 52% for plain fine-tuning. In the lab, the model fine-tuned on actions alone forgot how to name an object's color.
RT-2 просят протереть стол полотенцем. Т: RT-2 is asked to wipe the table with a towel. That motion isn't in the robot's demonstrations, but the internet has plenty of videos of it. Will it manage?
Нет: из веб-данных переносятся понятия,: No: concepts transfer from web data, but motions are limited to what is in the robot's demonstrations
Да: модель видела такое движение в интер: Yes: the model has seen that motion on the internet
Да, если добавить цепочку рассуждений: Yes, if you add chain-of-thought reasoning
Авторы прямо пишут, что физические навык: The authors state plainly that physical skills stay within the robot data, and wiping with a towel is on the list of failures. But “move apple to 3” works: the motion is familiar, and only the concept is new.
Почему RT-2 на 55 млрд параметров управл: Why does the 55B-parameter RT-2 control the robot only 1–3 times per second?
Такая модель работает в облаке на TPU, р: A model like that runs in the cloud on TPUs, the robot queries it over the network, and every action is several tokens in a row
Камера робота снимает три кадра в секунд: The robot's camera captures three frames per second
Так задумано: чем медленнее, тем точнее: It's by design: the slower, the more precise
Модель такого размера не запустить на бо: A model that size can't run on an onboard computer. The 5B-parameter version gives about 5 Hz. The authors admit this is a bottleneck for tasks that need high-frequency control; hence FAST, and π0 with a separate part for continuous actions, in lesson 3.6.
Лаборатория записала 200 эпизодов на сво: A lab recorded 200 episodes on its own robot and added them to the Open X-Embodiment mixture. The robot's actions are given in the camera's coordinate frame, while everyone else's are in the base frame. What will the common format do about this difference?
Ничего: формат нормирует действия по дат: Nothing: the format normalizes actions per dataset but leaves the coordinate frames and the meaning of the numbers alone, so the same vector will mean different motions for different robots
Переведёт действия в систему координат б: It converts the actions to the base frame, like everyone else's
Отбросит датасет: несовместимые координа: It drops the dataset: incompatible coordinates aren't allowed into the mixture
Авторы пишут прямо: координаты не совмещ: The authors say it plainly: coordinate frames aren't aligned, and the values stay absolute, relative or velocities, as the controller recorded them. In the lab, the unaligned axis left robot D without transfer.
Общий формат: один кадр и семь чисел: A common format: one frame and seven numbers
RT-1-X was trained on a mixture of nine robots. Where did it lose to RT-1 trained only on its own data, and why?
В больших доменах Bridge и RT-1: 35 млн: In the large domains, Bridge and RT-1: 35M parameters underfit the mixture, while in the small domains it won in 4 of 5
В малых доменах: чужие данные размыли ре: In the small domains: the other robots' data diluted the rare examples
Таблицы статьи: где перенос есть, а где: The paper's tables: where transfer works and where it doesn't
Из смеси для RT-2-X убрали датасет Bridg: The Bridge dataset, recorded on the WidowX robot, was removed from the RT-2-X mixture, and the model was tested on Google Robot on tasks from Bridge. What happens to the success rate?
Упадёт почти вдвое: с 75,8% до 42,8% — у: It drops by almost half, from 75.8% to 42.8%: the skills came over from WidowX through the common format
Не изменится: Google Robot в Bridge не с: It doesn't change: Bridge wasn't recorded on Google Robot, so it doesn't need that data
Вырастет: чужой робот только мешал: It goes up: the other robot was only getting in the way
Строка 3 таблицы II — та же модель и сме: Row 3 of Table II is the same model on the mixture without Bridge. That is positive transfer between robots: one robot's skills reached another through data, with no modules for each robot.
Четыре робота учатся на смеси: у робота: Four robots learn from a mixture: robot A has 300 demonstrations, robot D has 15. To help D, the weight of its dataset in the mixture was raised tenfold. What will the test show?
Просядет робот A: его доля в пакете упад: Robot A slips: its share of each batch drops, and the network starts memorizing D's 15 examples
Выиграют все: D получит больше внимания,: Everyone gains: D gets more attention, and the others lose nothing
Ничего не изменится: 15 демонстраций D —: Nothing changes: D's 15 demonstrations are a drop in the mixture
В лаборатории вес D ×10 ронял робота A,: In the lab, giving D ×10 weight dragged robot A down, and without A's data all the others slipped: A's 300 demonstrations covered the table better than the 155 demonstrations of the three small robots. Mixture weights are tuned by hand: for Octo and OpenVLA, the weight table takes up a separate page of the appendix, and the small datasets there are turned up, but not tenfold.
Смесь данных четырёх роботов на одном ст: Mixing four robots' data on one table
Чем Octo отличается от OpenVLA по устрой: How does Octo differ from OpenVLA in design?
Octo обучена с нуля на данных роботов и: Octo is trained from scratch on robot data and outputs actions with a diffusion head, while OpenVLA is a vision-language model that outputs actions as tokens
Ничем: OpenVLA просто больше: It doesn't: OpenVLA is just bigger
Octo — модель зрения и языка, а OpenVLA: Octo is a vision-language model, while OpenVLA is trained from scratch
Octo — трансформер на 93 млн параметров: Octo is a 93M-parameter transformer with no pre-training on internet data, apart from its language encoder. OpenVLA is built on Llama 2 with two vision encoders and writes each action axis as one of 256 bins.
Octo: входы и выходы добавляются токенам: Octo: inputs and outputs are added as tokens
Нужно перенести OpenVLA на свою руку, а: You need to adapt OpenVLA to your own arm, but you have a single GPU and can't fine-tune all 7B weights. What will rank-32 LoRA give you?
Почти то же, что полное дообучение: 68,2: Almost the same as full fine-tuning: 68.2% versus 69.7%, even though only 1.4% of the parameters are trained
Заметно хуже: учится в 70 раз меньше пар: Noticeably worse: 70 times fewer parameters are trained
Лучше полного дообучения на двадцать пун: Twenty points better than full fine-tuning
LoRA добавляет к каждой замороженной мат: LoRA adds a small trainable update B·A to each frozen matrix. Fine-tuning only the last layer gave the authors just 30.3%.
LoRA: учить небольшую добавку, а не всю: LoRA: train a small update, not the whole matrix
В записях оператор кладёт кубик то в лев: In the recordings, the operator puts the cube sometimes in the left bowl, sometimes in the right one. A model with a token head takes the most likely token. Where will it put the cube over ten attempts?
То в одну, то в другую, как диффузия: Sometimes in one, sometimes in the other, like diffusion
Токен первой оси выбирает одну миску, то: The token for the first axis picks one bowl, the token for the second follows it, and the answer doesn't change from attempt to attempt. It's regression that outputs the mean, and diffusion that answers with both bowls.
Голова действий: среднее, токены или диф: The action head: the mean, tokens or diffusion
Где закрытая RT-2-X всё ещё сильнее откр: Where is the closed RT-2-X still stronger than the open OpenVLA?
В задачах, где нужно знание из интернета: In tasks that need knowledge from the internet: RT-2-X was co-fine-tuned with web data, while OpenVLA was fine-tuned on robot data alone
Везде: открытая модель слабее во всех ка: Everywhere: the open model is weaker in every category
Нигде: OpenVLA сильнее на 16,5 пункта в: Nowhere: OpenVLA is 16.5 points stronger in every category
В среднем по 29 задачам OpenVLA сильнее: Averaged over 29 tasks, OpenVLA is 16.5 percentage points stronger, but in semantic generalization on the WidowX robot, RT-2-X is slightly ahead.
Таблицы OpenVLA: где открытая модель обх: The OpenVLA tables: where the open model beats the closed one
Как π0 выдаёт действия робота?: How does π0 output robot actions?
Эксперт действий за 10 шагов flow matchi: An action expert turns noise into a chunk of 50 continuous actions in 10 flow matching steps
Токенами, как OpenVLA, только корзин бол: As tokens, like OpenVLA, only with more bins
Отдельная модель без доступа к картинкам: A separate model with no access to the images outputs one action at a time
Картинки и текст проходят через модель з: The images and text go through the PaliGemma vision-language model, and the action tokens through a 300M-parameter action expert in the same transformer. Actions as tokens come from another variant, π0-FAST.
Модель зрения и языка и эксперт действий: A vision-language model and an action expert in one transformer
The robot receives commands 50 times per second. How many times per second is π0 called?
Около двух: одна пачка из 50 действий, р: About twice: one chunk of 50 actions, the robot executes 25 and gets a new chunk every 0.5 s
Вывод занимает 73 мс на RTX 4090, а 25 д: Inference takes 73 ms on an RTX 4090, and 25 actions of 20 ms each are half a second of motion. The chunk covers the motion between inferences.
Модель обучили только на аккуратных запи: A model was trained only on clean recordings of one task, without pre-training. What happens when the robot makes a mistake in the middle of the task?
Он плохо исправляется: в аккуратных запи: It recovers poorly: clean recordings contain no mistakes or corrections
Исправится лучше: данные чище: It recovers better: the data is cleaner
Ничего: на аккуратных данных модель не о: Nothing: a model trained on clean data doesn't make mistakes
The π0 authors call such a model brittle. Diverse pre-training data, mistakes included, provides corrections, and post-training on clean recordings provides quality.
Сначала много разных записей, потом немн: First lots of diverse recordings, then a few clean ones
Что делает токенизатор FAST?: What does the FAST tokenizer do?
Сжимает пачку косинусным преобразованием: It compresses the chunk with the cosine transform, rounding and BPE, so there are several times fewer tokens
Убирает токены и выдаёт непрерывные числ: It removes tokens and outputs continuous numbers
Секунда складывания футболки на 50 Гц —: One second of T-shirt folding at 50 Hz is 53 FAST tokens instead of 700 with bins. The catch is that π0-FAST outputs a chunk more slowly: the tokens are decoded one at a time.
FAST: сжать пачку, прежде чем резать её: FAST: compress the chunk before cutting it into tokens
Медленная модель работает 7 раз в секунд: The slow model runs 7 times per second, while commands from the chunk go to the arm 200 times per second. How fresh is the data in each command?
Им от 143 до 286 мс: все команды пачки п: It's 143 to 286 ms old: all the commands in a chunk are built from a frame captured before inference started
Им не больше 5 мс: каждая команда свежая: No more than 5 ms old: every command is fresh
Им всегда больше секунды: Always more than a second old
Частота команд и свежесть данных — разны: Command rate and data freshness are different things. A chunk is executed while the model thinks about the next frame. A fast system at 200 Hz brings the data age down to 5–10 ms because it looks at a fresh frame itself.
Что медленная система Helix передаёт быс: What does Helix's slow system pass to the fast one?
Один латентный вектор, смысл которого по: A single latent vector whose meaning emerges during training
Координаты цели и траекторию руки: The target's coordinates and the arm's trajectory
Медленная система сводит в один вектор в: The slow system packs everything the motions need to know about the task into one vector. Where the object is right now, the fast system sees for itself in a fresh frame.
Две модели с разными частотами в одной с: Two models running at different rates in one system
Человек передумал и просит взять другую: The person changes their mind and asks for the other cup. When will a two-level system start reaching for it?
Когда медленная система увидит просьбу и: When the slow system sees the request and finishes computing: in the lab at 7 Hz, after about 0.24 s
Через 5 мс: быстрая система работает 200: After 5 ms: the fast system runs 200 times per second
Только после того, как возьмёт первую ча: Only after it grabs the first cup
Просьбу читает только медленная система,: Only the slow system reads the request, so the reaction to a new command is bounded by its period and inference time. The fast system speeds up only what can be seen in the frame.
Рука догоняет чашку: одна модель и две с: The arm chases a cup: one model and two systems side by side
Что делает оркестратор Gemini Robotics-E: What does the Gemini Robotics-ER orchestrator do?
Планирует шаги, вызывает инструменты и п: It plans the steps, calls tools and passes the steps to the action model in plain words
Выдаёт углы суставов руке: It outputs joint angles to the arm
Держит равновесие робота 1000 раз в секу: It keeps the robot balanced 1,000 times per second
Сам оркестратор не двигает роботом: движ: The orchestrator itself doesn't move the robot: the motions come from the Gemini Robotics VLA. Balance 1,000 times per second is the job of the S0 level in Helix 02, which is a different system.
Gemini Robotics: облако, декодер на робо: Gemini Robotics: the cloud, a decoder on the robot and an orchestrator model
π0.5 должна работать в чужих домах. Каку: π0.5 has to work in other people's homes. What share of the examples in the first stage of its training were recordings of mobile robots cleaning up in homes?
Около 2,4%: остальное — другие роботы, в: About 2.4%: the rest is other robots, web data and step captions
Больше половины: иначе модель не работал: More than half: otherwise the model wouldn't work in homes
Ноль: модель учили только на веб-данных: None: the model was trained on web data only
Записей мобильных роботов в домах около: There are about 400 hours of recordings of mobile robots in homes. Generalization comes from the mixture: other robots' data brings motions, web data brings an understanding of objects and words, and step captions bring the ability to name subtasks.
Ко-обучение: записи нужной задачи — мала: Co-training: recordings of the target task are a small part of the data
Как устроена иерархия в π0.5?: How is the hierarchy in π0.5 built?
Одна и та же модель сначала пишет подзад: One and the same model first writes the subtask in words, then outputs actions that depend only on it
Это две отдельные модели, планировщик и: It's two separate models, a planner and a policy, as in SayCan
Подзадачи модели диктует человек: A person dictates the subtasks to the model
Авторы подчёркивают, что оба уровня — од: The authors stress that both levels are one model. In the lab, with 8 recordings of the long task, the hierarchical policy cleared 20 tables out of 20, and the flat one 7.
Сначала подзадача словами, потом действи: First a subtask in words, then actions
Есть бюджет на 96 записей. Что даст боль: You have a budget for 96 recordings. Which will do better in new homes: all the recordings in one home, or eight in each of twelve homes?
Двенадцать домов: при равном числе запис: Twelve homes: with the same number of recordings, generalization grows with the number of different locations
Один дом: модель лучше выучит задачу: One home: the model will learn the task better
Без разницы: решает только общее число з: No difference: only the total number of recordings matters
В лаборатории модель из одного дома выпо: In the lab, the model trained in one home carried out 85 of 128 commands in new homes, and the one trained in twelve homes 114, almost as many as a model trained in the test homes themselves. π0.5 trained in 104 locations works in new homes about as well as a model trained in those very homes.
Сколько домов нужно, чтобы работать в но: How many homes it takes to work in a new one
Что делает изоляция знаний при обучении: What does knowledge insulation do when training a VLA?
Не пускает градиент эксперта действий в: It keeps the action expert's gradient out of the vision-language model, which keeps learning from FAST tokens and web data
Замораживает модель зрения и языка целик: It freezes the whole vision-language model
Убирает веб-данные из обучения: It removes web data from training
Градиент случайно инициализированного эк: The gradient of a randomly initialized expert damages the vision-language model's knowledge: it follows commands worse and learns more slowly. Freezing it entirely doesn't work either: a model trained that way failed at the tasks.
Изоляция знаний: эксперт действий не дол: Knowledge insulation: the action expert shouldn't retrain the vision-language model
Одна модель ведёт захват туда, где чашка: The single model guides the gripper to where the cup was in its frame and doesn't grab the moving cup at any rate: in the lesson's lab, at 7 Hz with no network, the gripper trailed the cup by 3.2–4.8 cm against a 2 cm tolerance. Two systems grab it at any rate: the fast system sees for itself where the cup is right now, every 5 ms. But only the cloud model reads a new request, and the reaction is made up of the wait for the next frame, the inference and the network. At 1–2 Hz, Ada manages to close the gripper on the red cup before the response with the new request arrives; at 4 Hz she turns toward the blue one after 0.55 s, at 5 Hz after 0.45 s.
